headline: Turkish Central Bank Governor Vows to Defend Lira Amid Market Turmoil
summary: Turkish Central Bank Governor Fatih Karahan stated the bank is prepared to use interest rates and macroprudential tools to support the lira. The move aims to sustain disinflation efforts amid ongoing global market volatility.
why: The Turkish lira has faced significant pressure, and the central bank's intervention strategy is a key indicator for investors monitoring inflation and currency stability in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Turkish Lira
impacts.why: Central bank intervention is intended to stabilize and support the currency value.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Commitment to use policy tools to defend the currency typically reduces speculative selling pressure on the lira.
